title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema migrate-table --format json
description: Rows copied into one target table with an inline column mapping. The payload does not name the strategy (--strategy fdw or copy); both write this shape. The CLI assembles it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

target_table.description: The --target-table the rows went into, as given.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
